material.title: EFSA approves a novel food ingredient for use in dairy products
material.bodyOriginal: EFSA has authorised a novel food ingredient derived from a plant extract for use in dairy products at a maximum level of 2 g per serving, following a safety assessment that found no concerns for the general population. The authorisation applies from 1 January 2027.
